tasks.title: [W6] proofline uses truedone core for its forbidden-pattern and weakening checks
tasks.description: In the proofline repository, after truedone tags its first release: vendor packages/core/core.mjs from that tag into src/vendor/truedone-core.mjs, with the version on the first line of src/vendor/TRUEDONE_VERSION, and route scanForbidden's skip, focus, timeout and assertion checks through core.analyse, replacing the net count per file. proofline keeps its contract, gate and evidence code. Its suite stays green.

criteria.statement: forbidden checks run through the vendored truedone core
the net count of assertion lines per file is gone
an assertion moved between tests in one file is now caught by scanForbidden
the vendored file is byte-identical to the tagged truedone release

stop_rules: If a criterion cannot pass without loosening a threshold, skipping or deleting a test, raising a timeout, widening the scope or editing a file only Ryan changes: STOP and report file:line and the measured value.
If the task needs a decision that docs/spec.md does not settle: STOP and report BLOCKED naming the question. Do not choose.

If the environment a criterion needs is missing (the lead runner login, a token, the development app, Chromium, Python with pytest, Docker, the claude CLI): report BLOCKED naming the missing item; never mark a criterion passed by hand.
